title: fanoutqa: When were each of the New Seven Wonders of the World constructed? (0360a0d607c70e64)

chat_history.content: When were each of the New Seven Wonders of the World constructed?

content.content:
The user asks: "When were each of the New Seven Wonders of the World constructed?" Need to provide construction dates for each of the New7Wonders (modern list). Those are: Great Wall of China, Petra (Jordan), Christ the Redeemer (Brazil), Machu Picchu (Peru), Chichen Itza (Mexico), Roman Colosseum (Italy), Taj Mahal (India). Provide approximate construction periods. Need to answer with dates.

We can answer directly without external lookup, but we could verify dates. Probably can answer from knowledge. Provide years or periods.

We don't need to call function. Just answer.

content:
**New 7 Wonders of the World – Approximate dates of construction**

| Wonder | Country | Main construction period* |
|--------|---------|---------------------------|
| **Great Wall of China** | China | Began in the 7th century BC (earliest defensive walls) – the most famous sections (Ming Dynasty) were built 1368‑1644 AD. |
| **Petra** (the Rose‑Red City) | Jordan | Carved into the sandstone cliffs between ~ 312 BC (foundation of the Nabatean capital) and the 1st century AD. |
| **Christ the Redeemer** (statue) | Brazil | Constructed from 1922 to 1931; inaugurated on 20 October 1931. |
| **Machu Picchu** | Peru | Built during the height of the Inca Empire, roughly 1450‑1460 AD (often attributed to the reign of Pachacuti). |
| **Chichén Itzá** (the Pyramid of Kukulcán, etc.) | Mexico | Major construction spanned the Classic to early Post‑Classic periods, roughly 600‑1200 AD; the Temple of Kukulcán (El Castillo) dates to about 900‑1200 AD. |
| **Roman Colosseum** (Flavian Amphitheatre) | Italy | Built between 72 AD (groundbreaking under Emperor Vespasian) and 80 AD (completion under his son Titus); further modifications continued into the 2nd century AD. |
| **Taj Mahal** | India | Construction began in 1632 AD and was substantially completed in 1648 AD; the surrounding gardens and auxiliary structures were finished around 1653 AD. |

\* “Construction period” refers to the main phase when the monument as we know it today was erected. Many of these sites were expanded or modified over centuries, but the dates above capture the core building effort that gave each wonder its iconic form.
